newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Transwater ups stake in Prime.
newsitem.headline: Transwater ups stake in Prime.

text.p: Malaysian engineering services firm Transwater Corp Bhd said on Wednesday it has increased its equity interest in Prime Utilities Bhd by 1.36 percent to 22.87 percent for 19.95 million ringgit.
The national Bernama news agency quoted a Transwater statement as saying that Transwater bought the shares in the open market at an average price of 24.36 ringgit per share.
Prime stock ended Wednesday trading at 25.00 ringgit.
Prime, through a subsidiary, has been awarded a privatisation contract to operate Malaysia's sewerage treatment systems.
The purchases, done between Oct 17 and 24, were financed through borrowings, Transwater said.
